hero.eyebrow: The Saltbox Inn · bed and breakfast, Camden, Maine
hero.title: Four rooms,
hero.lede: A sea captain's house from 1840, two streets up from the harbor, with four rooms and blueberry pancakes. Scroll through a night here.

stages.c: The porch light is on and the door is open until nine. Your key is on the hall table.
A key on a rope fob, a harbor map, and a cookie from the jar by the stairs.
Up to the Captain's Room: a four-poster, a quilt, and the harbor lights from the window.
Old walls, new mattresses, and the foghorn far off. That's all you'll hear.
Wild blueberry pancakes, Maine maple syrup and coffee roasted in town.
The harbor is four minutes down the hill. Leave your bags in the hall.

rooms.title: Four rooms,
rooms.sub: Every room has a private bath, a good mattress and a quilt made in Maine. Pick one to see rates.

list.d: Front of the house, with the best view of the boats.
Ground floor, with a door onto the garden.
A four-poster and a window seat over the harbor.
Under the eaves, with a skylight over the bed.

dates.title: Pick your nights,
dates.sub: Rates are per room per night with breakfast for two. Fridays and Saturdays are two nights minimum in summer.

nearby.title: Park once,
nearby.sub: Everything in Camden is downhill from us, and the hike up Mount Battie starts at the end of the street.

places.d: Schooners, lobster boats and the library lawn.
Twenty-five minutes to the view over the bay.
A tiny bookshop with a big poetry shelf.
A walk along the water to the lighthouse.
